article.title: OpenAI推出金融業版ChatGPT，內建PitchBook等專業金融資料
article.summary: OpenAI周四（9/10）推出金融業專用的ChatGPT for Financial Services，以ChatGPT Work為基礎，結合GPT-6 Astra與專業金融資料，協助金融機構進行研究、建立財務模型及製作客戶資料，目前僅提供符合資格的金融機構使用。

article.title: China’s AI Industry Pivots to Agents From Models, Report Says
article.summary: China’s artificial intelligence industry is shifting from competition in large models and computing power toward the deployment and commercialization of AI agents, according to a report by the China Telecom Research Institute cited by China Central Television on Saturday.

article.title: Mistral wants open-weight AI to compete at the frontier. It just raised $3.5 billion to do it.
article.summary: This week, Mistral announced it raised €3 billion in a Series D funding round , pushing its post-money valuation past €21 billion. With the influx of cash — $3.5 billion in US dollars — it plans to expand its frontier research, scale compute capacity for model training, and grow its infrastructure.  Where Mistral’s allocating new funds suggests what the French AI company is betting on for the future of AI power: open-weight models can only do so much if the compute and infrastructure underneath remain concentrated among a few key players.  Open weights can only go so far So far, model superiority has been a major factor in who gets to rule the AI roost. article.title: Anthropic發布AI濫用威脅報告，宣稱7家中國業者蒸餾Claude以訓練自家模型
article.summary: Anthropic本周公布了AI濫用威脅報告，揭露各界濫用其模型Claude的各種型態，從網路攻擊、資訊操弄、AI輔助監控、開發傳統武器、生物濫用、詐騙與詐欺，以及非法蒸餾等，並直接點名7家中國AI實驗室的非法蒸餾行為，包括阿里巴巴的Qwen、月之暗面（Moonshot）、DeepSeek、智譜（Z.ai）、小米、商湯及MiniMax等。

article.title: OpenAI’s researchers burned $7,000 a day on AI agents — now it’s opening the floodgates
article.summary: OpenAI rolled out its Agents API in public beta Thursday, opening the backend behind Codex to developers looking to run agents unattended for days. Now, developers don’t have to build their own system to keep an agent going because the API keeps track of the job as it progresses and gives the agent somewhere to execute its work, even when a task stretches well beyond a single context window. Although that makes long-running agents easier to try, it also gives developers more ways to burn through compute. Interestingly enough, on the same day Agents API launched, OpenAI paused new sign-ups for its $200-a-month Pro plan after demand for GPT-6 Astra strained capacity. article.title: Google explains what’s going on with the disappearing speedometer in Maps on Android Auto
article.summary: TL;DR Google started bringing a live speedometer to Maps in Android Auto earlier this year. Earlier this week, some users reported no longer seeing the speedometer, as well as other map details. Google now explains that some users need to set a destination before the speedometer will appear. It’s a little shocking that it took until this summer for Google to start bringing a real-time speedometer to Maps on Android Auto , but better late than never! Combined with speed limit info in the app, that put some very useful information on Android Auto screens. And largely because we were so happy to see it finally arrive, we were particularly concerned earlier this week when we starting finding reports from users saying that it had suddenly vanished on them.
